items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he had a little band. So did Wade.

ctx.x: I saw him up there ten years ago, seven years ago. Was there any New Orleans bands operating up there when you went up there? You said you saw Clem Raymond. Did he have a band up there?
Yeah, he had a little band. So did Wade. But I can't remember who was in it?
Let me see. Buddy Petit, Wade and Frank(?) came out here to join Jelly Roll at this...oh, I can't remember the name of the place right now. Then they went back to New Orleans.
